title: Zero and Belle
subtitle: One rock, one romp
author: Storylight
blurb: Zero is eight and loves rocks. Belle is eleven months and loves to play. Two German shepherd sisters, one candy toy, and a very important stone.

magic.rock: There it is. Smooth as a secret.
magic.home: One rock. One candy. Two sisters on the couch.

openai.instructions: Warm gentle storyteller reading a family picture book about two real dogs. Soft, clear, never rushed. Zero is calm. Belle is bouncy. Give them kind voices without barking words.

pages.heading: Two sisters
pages.text: {Zero:zero/wag} is eight. She is brown as toast and calm as a Sunday. {Belle:belle/wag} is eleven months — jet black, skinny, long and tall, almost as big as Zero, tan only on her legs. She never sits still. Two sisters. One {couch}.
pages.hint: Tap Zero. Tap Belle. Tap the candy.

pages.heading: Zero loves rocks
pages.text: {Zero:zero/sniff} loved {rocks:rock/clack}. Smooth ones. Stripey ones. The one that fit her paw just so. She kept it like a treasure. Belle watched. Belle's tail said, I have an idea.

pages.heading: Belle loves to play
pages.text: {Belle:belle/wreck} loved to {play:candy/play}. She wrecked the pillow pile. She play-{bit:belle/bite} the rainbow {candy}. She bounced. She was always, always happy.
pages.hint: Tap Belle. She is a wrecking ball with ears.

pages.heading: The idea
pages.text: Then Belle {took:belle/run} Zero's {rock:rock/clack}. Zoom! Across the floor. Zero stood up, slow as an old queen. "That is my rock," she said, without words.
pages.hint: Tap Belle. She has the rock.

pages.heading: Into the yard
pages.text: Out they went. {Belle:belle/run} with the {candy:candy/play} in her mouth. {Zero:zero/run} followed, calm, because sisters do. The {yard} was full of grass and trouble.
pages.hint: Tap the yard. Tap both sisters.

pages.heading: The creek
pages.text: The {creek:creek/splash} was a box of {stones:rock/clack}. {Zero:zero/sniff} was in heaven. {Belle:belle/wreck} splashed every one. Water on the ears. Water on the candy. Happy.
pages.hint: Tap the water. Tap Zero's stones.

pages.heading: There it is
pages.text: In the grass sat the {rock:rock/find}. Smooth as a secret. {Zero:zero/wag} nosed it kind. {Belle:belle/bite} play-nipped the air, then dropped a tiny pebble at Zero's paws. "Yours," said the pebble.

pages.heading: Home on the couch
pages.text: Back on the {couch}. {Zero:zero/sleep} with her rock. {Belle:belle/sleep} with her rainbow {candy:candy/play}. Two sisters. One home. All happy.

end.heading: The End
end.text: You {read} the whole {story}. Zero loves rocks. Belle loves to play. That is how sisters work.
end.prompt: If you had a favorite rock, where would you keep it?

credits: Original story and painted scenes made for Storylight, from photos of Zero and Belle.
